reason: Candidate B more directly addresses the cited problem of contaminant-induced embrittlement in Ti–Ni-based alloys by proposing a physically sound and readily testable single-variable intervention (UHV processing) that is well grounded in prior evidence. Candidate A lacks direct existing evidence and changes the alloy to a two‐phase system, whereas B’s approach is more aligned with preserving and improving the material’s single-phase properties at high temperatures.
